results.llm_raw: {"say":"The goal is a cut half-shape; convert the hub-feed belts in place into a cutter plus trash so the incoming shape is cut to the required half and the byproduct is sunk.","calls":[{"macro":"replace_run","args":{"region":{"$bbox_of":["B135","B136","B137"]},"building":[{"kind":"cutter"},{"kind":"trash","port":"left"}]},"why":"cut the delivered shape to the required half and discard the other half, in place on the hub feeds"}]}

{"say":"The goal RuRu---- is a rotated half-shape; the hub feeders deliver 0 of it, so I convert the three belts entering the hub in place into rotaters so whatever half arrives gets rotated into the required top half.","calls":[{"macro":"insert_machine","args":{"at":{"$ref":"B135","asCell":true},"machine":{"kind":"rotater"},"opts":{"replace_belts":true}},"why":"Rotate the half carried by the first hub feeder into the goal orientation without leaving a dead belt."},{"macro":"insert_machine","args":{"at":{"$ref":"B136","asCell":true},"machine":{"kind":"rotater"},"opts":{"replace_belts":true}},"why":"Same in-place rotation on the second feeder in case it carries the other half."},{"macro":"insert_machine","args":{"at":{"$ref":"B137","asCell":true},"machine":{"kind":"rotater"},"opts":{"replace_belts":true}},"why":"Cover the third feeder so whichever line carries the left half yields the required top half."}]}

{"say":"Goal is a cut-and-rotated half-square; a cutter (C1) already splits shapes, so I convert its two output belts into rotaters so whichever half reaches the hub becomes RuRu----.","calls":[{"macro":"replace_run","args":{"region":{"$bbox_of":["B84"]},"building":{"kind":"rotater"}},"why":"rotate this cutter half into the needed RuRu---- orientation"},{"macro":"replace_run","args":{"region":{"$bbox_of":["B85"]},"building":{"kind":"rotater"}},"why":"hedge the other cutter output so the correct half is rotated either way"}]}

{"say":"No diagnosis and nothing delivered despite three hub lanes being wired: the hub run lacks the cutter that turns mined full shapes into the half-shape RuRu----, so I insert a cutter right on the hub-entry belt to produce the target half at the hub.","calls":[{"macro":"insert_machine","args":{"at":{"$ref":"B135","asCell":true},"machine":"cutter","opts":{"replace_belts":true}},"why":"place the shape-critical cutter on the delivery run into the hub so arriving full shapes are cut to the required half"}]}

{"say":"No diagnosis, and the only belts exposed are the two empty chains feeding balancer L3, so I rebuild those runs in place (belt mode) to clear any wrong-variant/broken cells and get material flowing toward the hub.","calls":[{"macro":"replace_run","args":{"region":{"$bbox_of":["B112","B105","B97","B90","B81","B69","B63"]},"building":"belt"},"why":"empty run into L3; in-place belt rebuild keeps every cell's topology and repairs bad belt cells"},{"macro":"replace_run","args":{"region":{"$bbox_of":["B98","B91","B82","B70","B64"]},"building":"belt"},"why":"the other empty run into L3, same in-place belt rebuild"}]}
